_comment: WHERE EACH DESK SITS ON THE DESKS-PAGE MAP — geography and placement only.
Nothing editorial lives here. Name, route, status, counts and scope come
from desks/registry.json and the database, exactly as on every other
surface. A registry desk with no entry here is still rendered on the
Desks page, in the list, with no map anchor; an entry here for a slug the
registry does not declare is ignored.
countries  Natural Earth ISO 3166-1 numeric ids emphasised for the desk.
seat       where the desk's publishing institutions are based; the anchor
is that place, not an area of coverage.
anchor     [lon, lat] of the seat, east-positive (Hawaii is 360-157.9).
card       where the desk's plate hangs at each layout (`wide` from 1100px,
`mid` from 760px; below that the plates are a list).
hang left|right: `at` is the [lon, lat] of the plate's top
corner and the plate extends that way from it; the leader
runs in along the plate's top rule.
hang up|down: the plate sits above|below the seat with its
bottom|top edge at `at`'s latitude (beyond the frame's edge
puts it outside the map); the leader is vertical and meets
the edge `align` (0-1) of the way across the plate.
Rebuild the base geometry with: python scripts/desk_map.py <countries-50m.json>
